reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly flags PhiFactory::createArt() for not binding the CreateConfig or the caller to the signature and lacking a nonce, allowing anyone to replay/frontrun the signature and set arbitrary artist/receiver/fees. This is the same signature-replay/impersonation issue described, on the same function and code path. The same remediation (bind CreateConfig and caller, add nonce) would fix both. The attack impact (diverting royalties/rewards to the attacker) also matches.
